label: The save-bound record is intentional because save chooses the target packet. Close the delivery gap selectively: reuse takeNudge at the next visible Claude lifecycle point and surface pending answers through existing save output for runtimes without a trusted hook. Do not add live record writers, another queue, or a second nudge cursor.

Do not add a Codex live adapter while project-hook trust is required. It is worth closing the matrix gap by adding Hermes as an explicitly unverified/unknown row; keep Cursor unverified until an answered question-tool event can be observed. Merge status into the existing coverage matrix and defer new adapters until runtime evidence exists.

The chat-pairing concern is worth narrowing: reuse the existing ordered-turn IDs for a unique direct answer and leave shared or ambiguous replies pending; validate that boundary with a multi-question live case before changing save instructions. The process-question filter is broader than keyword matching because it inspects headers, options, and permission wording; no second classifier is justified without a demonstrated false result. Keep the current filter and add only a narrow rule if evidence requires it.

The Codex and Pi unreadable-transcript behavior is worth fixing because it can make a failed recovery look empty. Remove the silent null-to-success path and use the existing Claude/Devin visible error and nonzero-exit convention only for actual read failures; keep readable empty transcripts quiet. A new generic error framework is not needed for two callers.

Do not consolidate the five runtime-owned storage formats into one parser: each reader handles a different host schema, and all sweeps already share normalizeAskUserQuestion, appendRecords, and chatCandidatesFromTurns. Pi live capture already reuses its save-time recoveredRecords parser. Keep decision-record-writer as the canonical upsert, decision-table-matcher as the single scoring/parser implementation, and the CLI as queue/consumption orchestration; merge only duplicated policy or error handling, and add no parallel writer, matcher, or normalization layer.
